"""mdata contract samples build their types; the load_prices fake serves the Prices sample."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import inspect

import pytest

import mdata
from mdata import GapError, Prices, RawRow


def test_exports_are_the_contract():
    assert sorted(mdata.__all__) == ["GapError", "Prices", "RawRow", "load_prices"]


def test_rawrow_sample_builds_rawrow(contract_sample):
    rows = [RawRow(**row) for row in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]
    assert len(rows) == 8
    assert {row.ticker for row in rows} == {"AAPL", "MSFT"}
    assert [row.close for row in rows].count(None) == 1


def test_prices_sample_builds_prices(contract_sample):
    payload = contract_sample("mdata.Prices")
    prices = Prices(
        dates=tuple(payload["dates"]),
        tickers=tuple(payload["tickers"]),
        closes={ticker: tuple(series) for ticker, series in payload["closes"].items()},
    )
    assert prices.tickers == ("AAPL", "MSFT")
    assert len(prices.dates) == 6
    assert all(len(prices.closes[ticker]) == 6 for ticker in prices.tickers)


def test_types_are_frozen():
    row = RawRow(date="2024-03-04", ticker="AAPL", close=1.0)
    with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
        row.close = 2.0  # type: ignore-free: assignment is what is under test
